desc: Implement complete Python solution using functional graph cycle peeling and O(NM) bottom-up DP.
Validate on sample inputs and edge cases such as self-loops, pure cycles, chains, and cycles with attached trees.
If sample tests fail, debug cycle handling and the distinction between prefix DP for non-cycle nodes and fixed-value DP for cycle nodes.
Optimize memory/time if needed by freeing child DP arrays after use and avoiding recursion.
